bullets.bullet_text: Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, establishing a repeatable technical pattern for regulated-enterprise cloud migration.
Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to safely adopt analytics and ML capabilities without compromising compliance posture.
Built a shared-responsibility operating model clarifying insurer-owned versus AWS-owned controls, giving regulated customers a clear governance framework for cloud adoption.
